description: Google Docs surgical authoring and workflow engine

commands.description: Execute an ordered Google Docs workflow from JSON (`steps` with `kind`).
commands.notes:
• Pipe stdin or pass one JSON document. Knobs: `dryRun`, `force`, `quiet` on the document.
• Each step requires `kind` (e.g. docOpen|docClose|docCreate|docCopy|query|markdownInsert|replaceSection|…).
• File-touching steps require `doc:` (raw id or open alias). `docCreate` binds `as`; `docCopy` uses `copyFrom`. There is no run-level documentId.
• Raw IDs only: extract between `/document/d/` and `/edit`. Full URLs are rejected.
• Surgical targeting: copy heading-scoped ids from `kind: query` into `nodeAt`, `nodeAfter`, or `nodeBefore` (e.g. `h.arch.9a1b`). NEVER compute startIndex/endIndex or write raw batchUpdate scripts.
• In-place updates: prefer `replaceSection`, `replaceMarkdown`, or `replace` over deleting and re-inserting content (no demolish-and-rebuild). Use `replace` or `replaceMarkdown` for heading titles; `replaceSection` on an H1 replaces all subsections under it.
• Real headings only (`TITLE`, `HEADING_1`–`HEADING_3`). No bullet glyphs in surgical text; use run-in bold (`**Label**: value`).
• Bindings: `docOpen` sets document aliases. Every `run` call is stateless; aliases do not persist across multiple `run` invocations. `dump: true` on docOpen/docCreate/docCopy dumps doc/tab metadata into `dumped[as]`. `query` with `as:` writes matches into `dumped[as]` (`output: markdown` or `nodes`). Query aliases cannot be used as mutation anchors.
• Cross-doc transfers: use `kind: sectionCopy` with `fromDoc:` and `fromSection:` to transfer sections server-side without streaming markdown, or query source with `output: markdown` and write with `replaceSection`. Anchors must always belong to the target `doc:`.
• Symbolic links: use `[Label](tab:TabTitle#HeadingTitle)`, `[Label](tab:TabTitle)`, or `[Label](#HeadingTitle)` in markdown; gdocsmith automatically resolves them to native Docs deep links (`?tab=...#heading=...`).
• Prefer one `run` per phase until step kinds are proven; then batch related steps. Chip/table writes use `kind: surgical`.
• Dry run: `dryRun: true` includes a unified git diff in the JSON `diff` field without writing.

force.description: Skip guards. Only if the user asked.

pageSetup.description: Document paper size and margins (applied once on live writes).

PageSetup.description: Document page setup geometry and margins.

alignment.description: Paragraph or table-cell alignment (START / CENTER / END / JUSTIFIED).

allTabs.description: Replace all occurrences across all tabs in textReplace.

afterTab.description: Insert or move this tab immediately after the specified tab title or ID.

as.description: On open/query: binds a doc or output alias.

beforeTab.description: Insert or move this tab immediately before the specified tab title or ID.

bullet.description: Convert this paragraph (and siblings sharing listId) to a Docs bullet preset.

cloneNode.description: Clone an existing node with style/bullet fidelity (heading-scoped id or ref).

cols.description: Scope query to table column indices (0-based).

copyFrom.description: Source doc ID or alias for docCopy.

copyFromDoc.description: Source doc ID or alias for tabCopy / tabDuplicate (defaults to doc).

copyFromTab.description: Source tab ID or title for tabCopy / tabDuplicate / tabAdd.

dangerousRemoveSection.description: Remove the heading and its following section.

doc.description: Target document ID or alias. Required on every step that reads or writes a file (`docCreate` binds `as` instead; `docCopy` uses `copyFrom`).

domain.description: Domain name for domain-level file permissions (docPermissionAdd).

dump.description: Dump document or tab metadata into `dumped[as]`.

elements.description: Detached element specs to insert in order.

email.description: Email address of grantee for docPermissionAdd or docPermissionRemove (alias for emailAddress).

emailAddress.description: Email address of grantee for docPermissionAdd or docPermissionRemove.

emailMessage.description: Notification email message body for docPermissionAdd.

fontColors.description: Scope query to foreground font colors (supports semantic colors like "red", hex like "#ea4335", and exclusions like "!#000000" or "!default").

force.description: Force destructive mutation even if targeting a fragile node.

fromDoc.description: Source document ID or alias for sectionCopy (defaults to doc).

fromSection.description: Source heading title, slug, or heading ID to copy from for sectionCopy.

fromTab.description: Source tab ID or title for sectionCopy (defaults to source doc active tab).

full.description: Keep every node in query dumps (no heading-only truncation; include table cells).

h1IsTitle.description: Treat top-level # as Title instead of HEADING_1.

headingLevels.description: Scope query to outline heading levels (0 = TITLE, 1 = HEADING_1, 2 = HEADING_2, etc.).

includeHeading.description: Whether to include the source section heading in sectionCopy (default true).

insertImage.description: Insert a public HTTPS inline image.

insertMarkdown.description: Insert rendered markdown at the anchor (surgical; prefer kind: markdownInsert).

markdownStyles.description: Named `::styleName[]::` directive styles (`{ alert: { color: "#f00" } }`). Distinct from native `style`.

moveToNewOwnersRoot.description: Whether to move the file to the new owner's root folder when transferring ownership (docPermissionAdd).

namedStyleType.description: Change namedStyleType on an existing paragraph.

nestingLevels.description: Scope query to bullet nesting levels (0 = root bullet, 1 = sub-bullet, etc.).

nodeAfter.description: Anchor node to insert after (heading-scoped id from query).

nodeBefore.description: Anchor node to insert before (heading-scoped id from query).

nodeKinds.description: Scope query to structural node kinds ("paragraph", "table", "sectionBreak", etc.).

noop.description: Internal flag indicating step was optimized into another step (e.g. hoisted into creation).

permissionId.description: Specific permission ID to revoke in docPermissionRemove.

replace.description: In-place text for `kind: replace` / `innerText`, or replacement string for `textReplace`.

replaceSection.description: Diff-replace a heading section with markdown.

role.description: Access level role for docPermissionAdd (commenter / fileOrganizer / organizer / owner / reader / writer).

rows.description: Scope query to table row indices (0-based).

runs.description: Explicit styled text runs for inline formatting.

sameList.description: When targeting a bullet list item with nodeUnder, scopes to contiguous bullet items sharing listId.

scope.description: Grantee access scope for docPermissionAdd or docPermissionRemove (anyone / domain / group / internal / user).

sendNotificationEmail.description: Whether to send an email notification to grantees on docPermissionAdd.

stylesOnly.description: Scope query to custom styled nodes only.

tableAlignment.description: Refused at apply time — Docs REST API has no table page alignment.

title.description: Title for docCreate / docCopy / tabAdd / tabCopy / tabDuplicate / docRename / tabRename.

transferOwnership.description: Whether to transfer file ownership to the grantee on docPermissionAdd.

unsafeOnly.description: Scope query to fragile nodes only.

BulletProps.description: Agent-supplied bullet on a NORMAL_TEXT paragraph.

fromDoc.description: Optional document ID to clone from.

fromTab.description: Optional tab ID to clone from.

nodeId.description: Scoped ID or tape index of the node to clone.

CloneNodeRef.description: Reference pointing to an existing node to clone.

WorkflowStepKind.description: Canonical workflow step kinds handled by the apply script engine.

NamedStyle.description: Docs named paragraph styles, including TITLE and SUBTITLE.

NodeKind.description: Structural element kinds on the body tape.

QueryOutputFormat.description: Serializer for `kind: query` matches written to `dumped`.

DrivePermissionRole.description: Role assigned to a Drive file permission.

InlineRunInput.description: Input specification for an inline styled run.

DrivePermissionScope.description: Grantee access scope for a Drive file permission.

backgroundColor.description: Text highlight background color hex string (updateTextStyle.backgroundColor).

borderColor.description: #RRGGBB on all four cell borders. Default width 1pt. Table or cell.

borderWidth.description: Border width in PT. Requires borderColor.

cellBackground.description: Table cell fill color hex string. Table node = every cell; cell id = that cell.

cellPadding.description: Cell padding in PT (all four sides). Table or cell.

cellTextAlignment.description: Explicit alias for cell paragraph alignment across a table or cell.

columnCount.description: Section columns (Format > Columns). Only on sectionBreak.

columnWidth.description: FIXED_WIDTH column(s) in PT (min 5). Table = all columns; cell = that column.

contentAlignment.description: Vertical cell alignment. Table or cell.

indentFirstLine.description: Glyph position in PT. Docs hanging lists: glyph here, text at indentStart. On a bullet, omitted with indentStart → indentStart − 18.

indentStart.description: Text indent in PT. Same field on insert and restyle. Flush level-0 list: indentStart 18 + indentFirstLine 0. Not a nest — use nestingLevel.

minRowHeight.description: Minimum row height in PT. Table = all rows; cell = that row.

pinnedHeaderRows.description: Number of pinned header rows. Table node only.

preventOverflow.description: Prevent table row from overflowing across page boundaries. Table or cell/row.

StylePatch.description: Optional style fields on a write op (`style`) or createElement.

CellContentAlignment.description: Vertical alignment inside a table cell (updateTableCellStyle.contentAlignment).

diff.description: Unified git diff of changes (populated on dryRun).

dryRun.description: True when `dryRun: true` previewed without writing.

dumped.description: Values extracted by `kind: query` (with `as:`) and `dump: true`.

highlights.description: Highlights of newly created docs, tabs, and headings.

ApplyHighlightHeadingJson.description: Newly created heading item in highlights.

commands.description: Print the program version.
Set up MCP config for this app (binary via Homebrew).
commands.notes:
Set up agent artifacts after the binary is installed via Homebrew (see README for tap install).

Homebrew installs the binary and shell completions only. Agent artifacts live under ~/.agents and are not written during brew install.

After install or upgrade:
  gdocsmith configure install

Upgrade:
  brew upgrade gdocsmith
  gdocsmith configure install

Shell completions are installed by Homebrew during brew install.
See: https://docs.brew.sh/Shell-Completion

See what is installed:
  gdocsmith configure status

Uninstall:
  gdocsmith configure uninstall
  brew uninstall <tap>/gdocsmith

Use `configure status --json` for machine-readable output.
